title: Filtered finite-constructible-complex heart presentations under a uniform local bound
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ annihilated by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E\}$, discrete for $A$ and with its induced $\ell$-adic topology otherwise [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Its condensed ring on profinite sets is $P\mapsto C(P,\Lambda)$, with all continuous functions. Let $X$ be an affine Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. Use the small étale and pro-étale sites and the small indexing universe [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}$ for schemes $T$ over $X$, with the ordinary uncompleted derived categories and actual module-derived global sections to abelian groups [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

Let $\mathcal C_X$ consist of the finite constant scalar-model constructible modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. A finite constructible complex here means a cochain complex $K^\bullet$ in $\mathcal A_X$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with only finitely many nonzero terms, each in $\mathcal C_X$; the differentials are arbitrary actual $\Lambda_X$-linear sheaf maps, not necessarily maps given by a common constant scalar matrix. Put $N_K=\ker(d^0:K^0\to K^1)/\operatorname{im}(d^{-1}:K^{-1}\to K^0)$, the zeroth cohomology module of this complex. No constructibility assumption is imposed on $N_K$.

Let $c\geq0$ be an integer. Assume that for every finite constructible complex $K^\bullet$ as above, every affine pro-étale object $v:U\to X$, and every integer $q>c$,
$$H^q\bigl(R\Gamma(U_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},v^*N_K[0])\bigr)=0.$$
Define $\mathcal I_X$ to be the replete class of modules isomorphic to small filtered colimits in $\mathcal A_X$ of modules $N_K$: the diagram is a diagram of the modules $N_K$ with arbitrary module maps, and is not required to lift to a diagram of complexes. Filtered categories and their colimits are as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then $\mathcal I_X$ contains zero and $\mathcal C_X$, is closed under kernels and cokernels of all morphisms between its members, and is closed under extensions and all small ambient coproducts. In particular extension closure refers to every ambient short exact sequence $0\to B'\to B\to B''\to0$ with $B',B''\in\mathcal I_X$, without requiring a pre-existing finite-stage lift of the extension. All the asserted resulting presentations are indexed by small filtered categories in the same indexing universe. No field of definition, invertibility of $\ell$, derived-completeness or finite-subextension-valued coefficient hypothesis is imposed. The Noetherian hypothesis is essential to this heart argument; the stated local bound alone does not imply the conclusion on arbitrary affine schemes. The empty scheme and the zero coefficient ring are included.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NN-8712600d7 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: E7 statement change accepted: arbitrary affine X narrowed to affine Noetherian X. I re-derived the counterexample to the original statement. X = Spec C_lc(βN,k) with char k = ℓ is w-contractible affine; take Λ = Q_ℓ and f = ext(ℓ^n). Q = coker f = N_K for [Λ_X -f-> Λ_X], so Q ∈ I_X. Every member of I_X has an injective counit L_0Γ → id: terms are lisse, so K = L(P) with P perfect (HRS Lemma 4.1(2)); R = C(βN,Q_ℓ) is semi-hereditary (Theorem 6.12), so L has amplitude [-1,0]; H^0 L(τ≤0 P) injects into N_K; this passes to filtered colimits. But B = im f = ker(Λ_X → Q) has counit Λ_X ↠ B with kernel the invisible sheaf of HRS Example 4.2 / Remark 6.4, so B ∉ I_X. HRS Lemma 8.6(2) supplies the local bound, so the bound does not save the statement. Step 1: lem-cbc-sieve-module-sheaves-grothendieck (applied at Z), sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor (closed monoidal, hence additive) and lem-sfb-modobj-grothendieck make A_X Grothendieck; these generic tool_uses are accepted. Step 2: the heart node's hypotheses match exactly. Step 3 (elementary): Z = ker d^0, im d^-1 = coker(ker d^-1 → K^-1) and N_K = coker(im → Z) all lie in C_X, so I_X = J. Step 4: the abstract node's hypotheses are met. New node lem-sfb-noetherian-scalar-constructible-heart is true: for adic Λ, t-admissibility (HRS Lemma 6.10, Corollary 6.11(1), including Q̄_ℓ with norm topology) and Theorem 6.2(3) heart = sk-def-sfb-constructible class; for A, lem-sfb-discrete-noetherian-constructible-serre. It is not a duplicate of det-lem-coefficient-heart-* (E and Q̄_ℓ via the qlbar-condensed ring only). New node lem-sfb-noetherian-scalar-constructible-fp2: HRS Lemma 5.3(2) with n=0 covers the regular rings; tested on A = Z/ℓ^2 with C = A/ℓ via Ext^p_A(P, H^q) for p+q ≤ 2 and the five lemma; WANTED flag is honest. Not a duplicate of sk-lem-constructible-ext-continuity (E, Q̄_ℓ, O_E with locally free a_!L only). New node lem-sfb-fp2-ind-realization faithfully abstracts the five paragraphs of the sk-prop-ind-heart proof; I checked filteredness, the AB5 kernels/cokernels and the extension pullback/pushout argument. It is not a restatement of the item; det-ind-heart-full-faithfulness-realization covers only the first paragraph. All three nodes: B1-B9 satisfied, from.node and via correct, three search kinds recorded, no SGA. Maintainer notes (not faults of this delivery): (1) live parent lem-sfb-torsion-cd-topological-serre-transfer step 2 uses this item for arbitrary affine X; it must be reopened with a new route. (2) Unsplit lem-sfb-qcqs-finite-complex-heart-filtered-closure (qcqs) is refuted by the same βN example; it is cited by lem-sfb-closed-torsion-rigidity-serre-transfer step 2. Mark it STATEMENT-DISPUTED and record both in HUMAN.md. No fixes written.
